title: Day and Trial Passes: guest-of-member discount and corporate sponsorship allotment basis
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: the discount off list price when a current member sponsors the visitor as a guest, whether that sponsoring member must be present at the same visit, the number of complimentary passes a corporate sponsor's employer may cover per month, the advance notice the sponsoring employer must give, and the fee charged when a corporate-sponsored pass exceeds that monthly allotment.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Guest-of-member discount | Sponsoring member must be present | Corporate sponsor monthly allotment (passes) | Corporate sponsorship notice (hours) | Fee if over allotment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 20% | Yes | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 15% | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | 10% | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | 10% | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Monthly Trial Pass | 0% | No | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 0% | No | 5 | 24 | 15.00 |

The guest-of-member discount is the percentage taken off a tier's list price when a current member sponsors the visitor's purchase. Where a tier's basis requires the sponsoring member to be present, as for the Single Day Pass, that member must check in at the same visit for the discount to apply; the other tiers carrying a guest discount do not require the sponsoring member's presence. Only the Corporate Guest Pass defines a corporate sponsor's monthly allotment, a minimum advance-notice period the sponsoring employer must give, and a fee charged when a sponsored pass exceeds that monthly allotment; the other tiers carry no such basis (all recorded as zero).
